New Custom Skylight Installation in San Francisco, CA
Natural light can completely transform a home, and that is exactly what this recent project in San Francisco accomplished. ROOF EXPRESS completed the installation of a brand-new custom skylight, giving the homeowner a brighter, more open interior while maintaining a fully watertight roofing system.
Custom Skylight Designed for the Home
Every skylight installation begins with precise measurements and careful planning. For this San Francisco project, our team installed a custom-sized skylight specifically designed to fit the existing roof structure and interior layout. The result is a seamless addition that brings abundant daylight into the living space and enhances the overall aesthetic of the home.
Professional Roof Integration and Waterproofing
Installing a skylight requires roofing expertise to ensure long-term performance. Our crew carefully cut the roof opening, framed the skylight, and integrated it with premium underlayment and manufacturer-approved flashing components. This process creates a durable waterproof seal that protects the home from leaks, even during San Francisco’s rainy and windy weather.

We also installed new shingles around the skylight to match the existing roof for a clean, finished appearance.
Benefits of a New Skylight
A custom skylight offers several advantages for homeowners in San Francisco:

Increases natural light

Makes rooms feel larger and more inviting

Improves ventilation when operable models are selected

Reduces dependence on artificial lighting

Adds value and architectural appeal to the home

With proper installation, a skylight becomes one of the most attractive and functional upgrades a homeowner can make.
ROOF EXPRESS – San Francisco Skylight Installation Experts
ROOF EXPRESS is a Diamond Certified and GAF Certified roofing contractor specializing in custom skylight installation, roof replacement, and waterproofing throughout San Francisco and the Bay Area.

If you are considering adding a custom skylight to your home, contact ROOF EXPRESS for a free consultation. Our experienced team ensures precise installation and long-lasting protection.

Call ROOF EXPRESS today at 650-666-5554 or visit ROOF EXPRESS to schedule your free estimate.
